rationale: Sharon brings deep expertise in production-ready AI agent infrastructure for regulated industries like biotech and fintech, while Allen supports Build AI's consumer-facing AI efforts—complementary angles on the AI stack that could surface useful perspectives on scaling from enterprise rigor to consumer adoption. A quick conversation could help both understand how infrastructure decisions differ across these markets.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Allen Xu — he's supporting Build AI on the consumer AI side, and your work on agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries might offer useful contrast on product and reliability tradeoffs.
